org.redown.authority: Behavior-derived preservation candidate, not a claim of flawless operation.
org.redown.confidenceMeaning: 0 is a conservative required-field value, not measured probability
org.redown.evidenceScope: offline source/local fixtures; installed Chrome and live provider unverified

name: Check and package extension preservation boundary
statement: Use explicit syntax targets, regression policy and package allowlist to audit shipped extension. Preserve its existing external behavior while addressing defects; known limits remain explicit.

verification.expected: Retain applicable fixture behavior and explicitly add missing acceptance evidence.
